$comment: Phase 0 — General map dataset. Dummy file showing how pinned + custom + categorized points live together with categories and nested collapses.
//meta: Optional. Human-facing dataset info (not drawn on the map).

meta.//id: Stable dataset id string (storage / selector / sharing).
meta.title: Demo Map
meta.//description: Longer summary of the map contents.
meta.description: Dummy dataset showing all marker kinds and a nested zone.

//categories: Either a path string to a categories file, OR an inline categories object (same shape as example_categories.json).
//points: Array of mixed-kind markers. Each item must set kind and the fields required for that kind.

points.name: Demo Map Center
points.description: Pinned: never clusters, excluded from category search.
points.//picture: Pinned: own marker image(s). Array of strings; can be [].
points.//isCollapsible: Optional. Key into collapses. Omit if no nested zone.

points.name: Demo Photo Stop
points.description: Custom: large photo rectangle with priority.
points.//picture: Custom: required non-empty string array of image URLs/paths.
points.//priority: Integer >= 0. Higher wins when custom markers are close.

points.name: Demo Cafe
points.//type: Non-empty array of category ids from categories.json.
points.//picture: Categorized: optional gallery images for detail UI. Use [].
points.//cluster: Boolean. Usually true for pin categories.

points.name: Demo Museum
points.description: Example of a categorized point using an icon-style category.

points.name: Demo Landmark
points.description: Example of a categorized point using a picture-style category.
points.//cluster: Picture-style categories often set false so they stay unclustered.

//collapses: Object map. Keys = isCollapsible values. Values = nested { polygon, points }.

zone-a.json.//polygon: Optional highlight polygon while nested zone is open. Use null if none.

polygon.//color: CSS color string for the polygon.
polygon.//coordinates: Array of {lat,lng} ring vertices. Need at least 3.

zone-a.json.//points: Markers shown only inside this nested zone (same point shapes as top-level).
